decisions.reason: Premium support is a low-cost option close to current services; keeping it open preserves flexibility while demand uncertainty remains unresolved.
The version management tool builds on established technical capabilities and may now be integrated into the platform, so keeping it as an option at moderate cost is justified.
The data-processing contract tool is distant from the core and has not shown market presence, making its continued legal maintenance costs exceed the remaining option value.
Scalable hosting for agencies is the firm's flagship and directly aligns with its agency-focused strategic direction, so it warrants continued commitment.
